imageSlots.prompt: Webinars video/speaker thumbnails, Balencia warm-dark glass UI asset, privacy-safe, no brand logos, no readable UI text

trustControls: Media consent-gated: no identifiable face, body, home, document, provider logo, or private text without explicit permission
Source chips expose category, source, scope, freshness, retention, export, revoke, and delete
Navigation stays aligned to /webinars, /webinars/[slug] only — no alternate vanity routes
Share uses public URL only, never private plan or health data
notes: Single BtnPrimary per screen (Register). Recording progress fills only to real 38%, never fabricated. Skeleton: session cards show date/title/speaker geometry, no fake seat counts. Empty: HonestNullState varies per tab — no upcoming, no registrations, or no recordings. Error: failed registration or recording keeps session visible, names the failed action. Success: registration confirms, --glow-done flashes, next step (calendar/recording) appears. Disabled: register/watch/calendar 40% opacity with reason (signed-out, sold out, unpublished, permission-blocked, offline). GlassNavBar carries no forced active tab.
